feedback.name: Figma — offline mode + collaborative feedback boards
feedback.content: Customer call with Figma: "Two asks — offline mode so our team can review feedback without connectivity, and better real-time collaboration on the feedback boards themselves, the way our design tool works. Right now it's single-player."

feedback.name: Stripe — bulk API import + webhooks for feedback
feedback.content: Slack thread from Stripe: "We get feedback across a dozen channels — we need a bulk API to import it programmatically and webhook events when new feedback lands so we can route it. Manual entry doesn't scale for us."

feedback.name: Notion — mobile usage reporting / DAU export
feedback.content: Survey response from Notion: "Our PMs can't pull mobile-specific DAU/WAU numbers — discovery is the issue, we can't see adoption of the mobile app. Would love exportable usage reporting tied to feedback themes."

feedback.name: Datadog — SSO/SAML for the mobile app (Okta)
feedback.content: Call with Marcus Hale (VP Product, Datadog): "We're scaling our product org and the blocker for rolling this out to all 40 PMs is SSO — we need the mobile app to support our Okta SAML setup. Also need usage reporting we can export (DAU/WAU) for mobile specifically."

📞 Call with Dana Okafor — Bridgepath Solutions
Participants: Rachel Kim (Account Executive), Dana Okafor (CTO)Date: April 10, 2026

[00:55] Dana: So we’re ready to expand — we’ve got another 200 users we want to roll onto the platform. Mostly mobile-first folks, sales and field service.
[01:20] Rachel: That’s exciting. What do you need from us to make that happen smoothly?
[01:28] Dana: A few things. First, SSO — we need the mobile app to support our Okta setup. Right now the desktop does but mobile still uses password login and our IT team won’t allow it at scale.
[02:05] Rachel: That’s on the roadmap — I’ll check the timing.
[02:12] Dana: Good. Second is usage reporting. My manager is going to ask how many people are actually opening the app each week. Right now I can’t pull DAU or WAU data for mobile specifically — it’s all lumped together with web.
[02:50] Rachel: Mobile-specific analytics. Got it.
[02:55] Dana: And third — offline mode. Our field crews are in areas with spotty signal. The web app is useless there, and right now mobile just shows an error. Even read-only offline access would unblock a whole segment of users.
[03:30] Rachel: These are all really clear requirements. Let me set up a follow-up with our product team so they can give you real answers on timelines.

Survey: Post-Launch Mobile App Experience Survey (April 2026 cohort)
Customer
Yuki Tanaka
Company
Novara Consulting
Role
Senior Analyst
NPS Score
6
Time using mobile app
3 weeks
What would most improve your experience with the mobile app?

Honestly the app itself is fine, it’s fast and I like the new design. My issue is discovery — I didn’t even know we had a mobile app until someone on my team mentioned it 6 months into our subscription. There was no email, no in-app prompt on desktop saying "hey, we have a mobile app, here’s the link." I would have downloaded it on day one if I’d known. I’ve asked a few colleagues and same story — most of them found out by accident. Feels like there’s a real opportunity to drive downloads just through better awareness within the product itself. Add a banner, send an announcement email, something. The product is good once you’re in it.
